authority_note: This registry is a discovery projection, not an authority. The driver scripts under pig-fb/ define what each strategy actually does; if this file drifts from the implementations, the implementations win. Workers consult this file at runtime to pick the preferred strategy and to decide whether a fallback strategy is worth attempting. Fix the file when it disagrees with observed reality, never the reverse.

conventions.fallback_rule: On an unexpected zero (suspicion level >= 1), attempt the healthiest non-preferred strategy with health != broken before declaring ENUMERATION_FAILURE. A health=broken strategy is skipped with a recorded reason; it is never attempted automatically.
conventions.health_updates: A driver updates healthScore/lastSuccess/observedCount when it observes the strategy live. Manual updates require an observed run date; do not set health on guesswork.
conventions.how_to_add_a_capability: Copy the schema of an existing entry: top-level key is the capability name (verb_object), with description, preferredStrategy, and strategies[]. Each strategy has: name, description, health (good|degraded|broken|unknown), healthScore (0-100), lastSuccess (ISO date or null), observedCount (int or null), confidence (high|medium|low|none), preferred (bool), notes. Set preferredStrategy to the name of the last-known-good strategy. Never mark a strategy preferred if health is broken or unknown without an observed success.
